title: Contemporary Soul
tagline: Warm, direct singing shaped by modern production and a broad field of influences.
summary: Contemporary soul keeps the emotional clarity of classic soul while absorbing newer production methods and rhythmic language. It can be intimate or expansive, but it usually centers the voice and the feeling behind the lyric. Its range is wide, from sleek radio cuts to deeper, more meditative recordings.

pillars.name: Alicia Keys
pillars.why: Alicia Keys combined classic soul singing with modern rhythm and a strong sense of emotional detail.

pillars.name: Maxwell
pillars.why: Maxwell made smooth, intimate R&B feel rich, stylish and deeply musical.

pillars.name: Mary J. Blige
pillars.why: Mary J. Blige ensured contemporary soul carried weight, honesty and a lived-in vocal texture.
